briefings.message: Kyle Harrison is the high-confidence starter prediction. His four-seam fastball and slurve make up most of his mix, so be ready for either and don’t chase the breaking ball. Michael Conforto has the strongest projected matchup, but that edge relies on small samples. Attack your individual pitch as planned, and stay patient if Milwaukee turns to Trevor Megill, Abner Uribe, Aaron Ashby, or Chad Patrick late.
